rdfs:label: closed
rdfs:comment: Indicates that an ActivityStreams Question is closed — no further responses are accepted. The value may be a date-time, a boolean, or an Object describing how it was closed.
notes: Most often a `xsd:dateTime` carrying the close timestamp — clients render "poll ended at …" and stop accepting votes. The boolean form simply marks the Question closed without a time. Some servers also accept an Object value pointing at the activity that closed the poll.

examples.title: A Question with an explicit close time
